page: Microsoft Azure E48ads_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the EADSv5 server family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 7763 processor. The server features 48 virtual CPUs mapped to 24 physical cores with multithreading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 3.525 GHz. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Storage is bundled as a 1843 GB local disk, and the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

Benchmark data highlights strong computational and memory performance. In stress-ng testing, both single-core and multi-core CPU performance rank in the top 25 percent. Passmark CPU and memory scores are also strong, with the CPU encryption test reaching 51420.58 and the overall memory score landing in the top 25 percent at 2931.27. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression is highly efficient at 245.66 GB/sec. While memory bandwidth and database operations perform in the average tier, the server demonstrates strong text generation capabilities for small language models, processing 304.6 tokens per second.

Given its high memory density and dedicated AMD EPYC processor, the E48ads_v5 offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound enterprise workloads that require substantial local scratch space. The inclusion of a 1843 GB local disk reduces the need for external storage attachments for temporary data. This hardware profile is well-suited for large-scale databases, memory-intensive analytics, enterprise applications, and multi-threaded data processing tasks.
